```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load_data_community}
load("data/coassemblies_data.Rdata")
load("data/coassemblies_genome_gifts.Rdata")
load("data/coassemblies_alpha.Rdata")
load("data/coassemblies_beta.Rdata")
```

Is the gut microbiome of the 4 experimental groups the same, at Time point 1 (post-acclimation, pre-ABX, all newts kept at 10C)?

```{r}
# Richness
alpha_div %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
  filter(experiment_phase %in% c("PRE-1", "PRE-2", "PRE-3")) %>%
  filter(metric=="richness") %>% 
  summarize(kruskal_p_value = kruskal.test(value ~ experimental_group)$p.value) %>%
  pull(kruskal_p_value)
```

```{r}
# Neutral
alpha_div %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
  filter(experiment_phase %in% c("PRE-1", "PRE-2", "PRE-3")) %>%
  filter(metric=="neutral") %>% 
  summarize(kruskal_p_value = kruskal.test(value ~ experimental_group)$p.value) %>%
  pull(kruskal_p_value)
```
```{r}
# Phylogenetic
alpha_div %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(., sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
  filter(experiment_phase %in% c("PRE-1", "PRE-2", "PRE-3")) %>%
  filter(metric=="phylogenetic") %>% 
  summarize(kruskal_p_value = kruskal.test(value ~ experimental_group)$p.value) %>%

```
```{r}
# Plotting
alpha_div %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
  filter(experiment_phase %in% c("PRE-1", "PRE-2", "PRE-3")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    y = value,
    x = experimental_group,
    group = experimental_group,
    color = experimental_group,
    fill = experimental_group
  )) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ factor(
      metric,
      levels = c("richness", "neutral", "phylogenetic"),
      labels = c("Richness", "Neutral", "Phylogenetic")
    ),
    scales = "free",
    ncol = 5
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
samples_beta_pre <- sample_metadata %>%
  filter(experiment_phase %in% c("PRE-1", "PRE-2", "PRE-3")) %>%
  select(EHI_number) %>% 
  pull()

sample_metadata_beta_pre <- sample_metadata %>%
  filter(experiment_phase %in% c("PRE-1", "PRE-2", "PRE-3"))

length(samples_beta_pre)
```
```{r}
# Richness
beta_q0n_mat <- as.matrix(beta_q0n$q0S)
beta_q0n_filtered_pre <- beta_q0n_mat[
  rownames(beta_q0n_mat) %in% sample_metadata_beta_pre$EHI_number,
  colnames(beta_q0n_mat) %in% sample_metadata_beta_pre$EHI_number
]
beta_q0n_dis <- as.dist(beta_q0n_filtered_pre)

sample_metadata_beta_pre_ordered <- sample_metadata_beta_pre %>%
  filter(EHI_number %in% labels(beta_q0n_dis)) %>%
  arrange(match(EHI_number, labels(beta_q0n_dis))) %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "EHI_number")

betadisper(beta_q0n_dis, sample_metadata_beta_pre_ordered$experimental_group) %>% permutest(., pairwise = TRUE) 
```
```{r}
adonis2(beta_q0n_dis ~ experimental_group,
        data = sample_metadata_beta_pre %>% arrange(match(EHI_number,labels(richness))),
        permutations = 999) %>%
        broom::tidy() %>%
        tt()
```

```{r}
# Phylogenetic
beta_q1p_mat <- as.matrix(beta_q1p$q1S)
beta_q1p_filtered_pre <- beta_q1p_mat[
  rownames(beta_q1p_mat) %in% sample_metadata_beta_pre$EHI_number,
  colnames(beta_q1p_mat) %in% sample_metadata_beta_pre$EHI_number
]
```

```{r}
adonis2(beta_q1p_dis ~ experimental_group,
        data = sample_metadata_beta_pre %>% arrange(match(EHI_number,labels(richness))),
        permutations = 999) %>%
        broom::tidy() %>%
        tt()
```
```{r}
beta_q0n_dis %>%
                metaMDS(.,trymax = 500, k=2, verbosity=FALSE, trace=FALSE) %>%
                vegan::scores() %>%
                as_tibble(., rownames = "sample") %>%
                left_join(sample_metadata_beta_pre, by = join_by(sample == EHI_number)) %>%
            group_by(experimental_group) %>%
            mutate(x_cen = mean(NMDS1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
            mutate(y_cen = mean(NMDS2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
            ungroup() %>%
            ggplot(., aes(x=NMDS1,y=NMDS2, color=experimental_group)) +
                geom_point(size=2) +
                geom_segment(aes(x=x_cen, y=y_cen, xend=NMDS1, yend=NMDS2), alpha=0.2) +
        labs(y = "NMDS2", x="NMDS1 \n Richness beta diversity") +
                theme_classic() +
                theme(legend.position="none")
```

No significant differences detected between experimental groups before any treatments. Yay!

What about between G2 (HOT acclimated) and the other 3 (still at 10C) after the temp was modulated?

would need to sequence more samples --> currently no samples from 20C pre-ABX
